The successful candidate will work closely with farmers, internal teams, and certification bodies to ensure compliance with FSC standards and facilitate a smooth certification and audit process.This is a hands-on role that requires fieldwork, site mapping, documentation, stakeholder engagement, and a strong understanding of FSC certification requirements.Key ResponsibilitiesFSC Certification: mapping of all relevant farmer plots and forest sites, ensuring accurate geographical records and maps are available for certification and audit purposes.Documentation and Compliance: Prepare, Management (FM) and Chain of Custody (CoC) standards and certification procedures.Experience in forest or farm mapping, GPS-based data collection, GIS tools, or geospatial mapping.Ability to prepare and manage technical documentation, audit records, compliance reports, and site-level data.Strong communication and coordination skills, particularly when working with farmers and field teams.Willingness and ability to travel regularly between sites.A valid driving licence is essential, as the role involves frequent field visits.What We OfferSalary of up to ₹60,000 per month, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.Company car provided for site visits.An opportunity to lead the development and implementation of an FSC certification programme from the ground up.A field-oriented role with the opportunity to work directly with smallholder farmers and contribute to responsible forest management and sustainable supply chains.

Strong leadership, problem-solving, coordination, and communication skills.

title: Factory Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

K P Namboodiri's Ayurvedics (KPNA) is a heritage Ayurvedic products company founded in 1925, headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala. Oral care is its core category, with skin care and hair care as growth areas. The Company is strengthening its manufacturing and functional leadership to support its next phase of growth.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Factory Manager will run KPNA's personal care manufacturing unit at Vadakkekad, Thrissur. The role is accountable for production output, quality, cost, safety and people at the unit. It reports to the DGM, Operations. This is a hands-on role, based at the plant, with close involvement in daily shopfloor work.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Plant Operations**

•   
Run the day-to-day operations of the unit, covering production, maintenance, in-process quality checks and in-plant stores.

•   
Meet the monthly production plan for volume, quality and cost.

•   
Make good use of manpower, machines and materials across shifts.

•   
Keep production records, batch documents and daily reports accurate and up to date.

**2. Production Planning and Coordination**

•   
Prepare weekly and daily production schedules from the plan agreed with the DGM, Operations.

•   
Give material requirements to Supply Chain and Purchase on time, and flag shortages early.

•   
Coordinate with the Central Depot on the transfer of finished goods.

**3. Quality and Compliance**

•   
Make sure every batch is produced as per approved formulas, SOPs and Good Manufacturing Practice.

•   
Work with Quality Control on in-process checks, rejections and customer complaints, and close the root causes.

•   
Keep the plant ready for statutory and licensing inspections, and maintain the records these require.

**4. Maintenance and Hygiene**

•   
Plan and carry out preventive maintenance, and keep breakdowns and downtime low.

•   
Maintain hygiene and housekeeping standards suited to personal care manufacturing.

**5. Safety**

•   
Own workplace safety on the factory floor. This covers safe work practices, use of protective equipment, and reporting and follow-up of incidents.

**6. Cost and Improvement**

•   
Track and reduce wastage, rework and material loss.

•   
Suggest and carry out practical improvements to output, yield and changeover time.

**7. People**

•   
Lead supervisors and workers across shifts. Assign work, set daily targets and review progress.

•   
Assess manpower needs and raise requisitions through the DGM, Operations. HR handles recruitment, statutory welfare compliance and grievances.

•   
Train and develop supervisors to take on more responsibility.

**KEY SUCCESS METRICS**

•   
Adherence to the production plan

•   
Conversion cost per unit

•   
Wastage, rejection and rework levels

•   
First Pass Yield and customer complaints traced to manufacturing

•   
Machine downtime

•   
Safety incidents, and closure of inspection and audit observations

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

•   
Graduate in engineering, chemistry or pharmacy.

•   
10 to 15 years of manufacturing experience, with recent experience leading production.

•   
Experience in FMCG or related industries is preferred, but is not a pre-requisite for the right candidate.

•   
Working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice.

•   
Willing to be based in Thrissur. Knowledge of Malayalam is preferred.

**CAPABILITIES**

•   
Hands-on shopfloor leadership

•   
Production planning and scheduling

•   
Practical problem solving on quality and machine issues

•   
Awareness of cost and wastage

•   
Ability to train and manage a shopfloor team

•   
Clear and regular reporting

**WHY THIS ROLE**

The role offers full charge of an established plant making products for a brand with a century-old heritage. The Factory Manager will have a clear reporting line and defined support from Supply Chain, Quality Control and HR. There is room to grow as KPNA expands its manufacturing.

title: Snr BIM Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
RDS is a global team of experienced design, BIM, and engineering professionals specializing in fully coordinated, multi-disciplinary BIM projects. The team combines tier-one technical expertise with innovative digital construction technologies to deliver buildable, disciplined designs that improve onsite certainty and efficiency. By leveraging advanced virtual design tools, RDS enhances coordination, minimizes miscommunication, and enables clients to visualize projects before construction begins. With services spanning BIM, design development, planning and scheduling, documentation, estimating, logistics, and virtual design construction, RDS supports projects worldwide through robust communication and collaboration platforms. The company focuses on long-term value, using a “begin with the end in mind” approach to provide data that supports asset management throughout the lifecycle of built assets.

**Role Description**
The Snr BIM Engineer is a full-time, hybrid role based in Chalakkudy, with some flexibility for work from home. This role is responsible for leading and managing multi-disciplinary BIM models across architecture, civil, and MEP disciplines, ensuring accurate coordination and clash-free design solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing detailed construction drawings and shop drawings, overseeing model integrity and standards, and collaborating with design and engineering teams to resolve technical issues. The Snr BIM Engineer will support project planning and scheduling through model-based workflows, contribute to quantity take-offs and documentation, and provide guidance to junior team members on BIM processes and best practices. The role also involves liaising with clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery of BIM outputs and alignment with project objectives and industry standards.

**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools and workflows, with proven experience in leading multi-disciplinary BIM projects.
* Ability to produce and review detailed Construction Drawings and Shop Drawings aligned with project specifications and local/international standards.
* Experience working with Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems in coordinated models, including clash detection and resolution.
* Background in Architecture and/or Civil Engineering with a solid understanding of structural, architectural, and building services integration.
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Building Services, or a related discipline; advanced BIM or VDC certifications are an advantage.
* Proficiency in industry-standard BIM and design software (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and related coordination tools).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and coordination skills, with attention to detail and an ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, including experience working in cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Experience in construction planning, sequencing, and model-based quantity take-off or estimation is beneficial.

title: QA Manager (Australia Migration GSM)
description:
**Job description:** 




 The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories.
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. Setting the Quality Standard
 



 –Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved
 



 –Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward
 



 –Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it
 



 –Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure
 



 2\. Checking Files Before Submission
 



 –Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority
 



 –Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements
 



 –Gives final approval — nothing gets lodged without QA sign\-off
 



 3\. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules
 



 –Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines
 



 –Updates the team quickly whenever rules change
 



 –Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements
 



 4\. Improving How Things Work
 



 –Creates clear step\-by\-step processes for the team to follow
 



 –Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly
 



 –Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening
 



 5\. Reducing Errors and Rejections
 



 –Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from
 



 –Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened
 



 –Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again
 



 –Works toward getting files right the first time, every time
 



 6\. Reporting to Leadership
 



 –Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing
 



 –Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends
 



 –Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly
 



 7\. Working With Other Teams
 



 –Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff
 



 –Makes sure quality is not just a QA job — it runs through the whole business
 



 –Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk
 



 8\. Training the Team
 



 –Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills
 



 –Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes
 



 –Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager
 



 9\. Protecting Client Information
 



 –Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private
 



 –Follows all legal and company rules around data protection
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 –Has a relevant degree
 



 –Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services
 



 –Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years
 



 –Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires
 



 –Has used case management or CRM systems before
 



 –Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus
 



 Work Location: In person

title: Technical Superintendent

* Ensure compliance with maritime legislation, safety regulations, and certification requirements.
* Plan and execute vessel inspections, audits, and follow\-up actions to enhance operational standards.

* Support and mentor sea staff, identify training needs, and provide onboard training during visits.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Minimum 3 years of sailing experience as Senior Officer OR 3 years of shore experience as Technical Superintendent in a ship management or owning company.

**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of vessel technical requirements and voyage regulations.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective negotiation and people management abilities.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English with diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in PC applications and digital tools.


**Why You Should Join Us!**

* On\-the\-job training.
* First\-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
* Diverse workforce.
* Technology\-driven company.
* Be a part of the ever\-growing Schulte group family!

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
* To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period.
* EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis.
* For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
* At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
   

  

 All in to shape the future with confidence.
   

  

 EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.
   

  

 EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1\-800\-EY\-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

title: Civil Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




 Mindscape Architects is a multidisciplinary design studio founded in 2002 by Ar. M.M. Jose, bringing together a skilled team of architects and designers. The studio specializes in architecture, interior design, furniture design, and landscape design, delivering cohesive and thoughtful built environments. The team works closely with clients, integrating their input with professional expertise to create exceptional, user\-centered spaces. With a principled and dedicated approach, Mindscape Architects consistently delivers innovative, functional, and aesthetically refined designs. The firm is committed to transforming spaces in ways that meet and often exceed client expectations and project visions.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are seeking a dedicated and detail\-oriented Civil Engineer to join our team in Kanjirapally. This is a full\-time, on\-site role involving civil engineering design, technical drafting, quantity estimation, site supervision, and project coordination. The ideal candidate will work closely with architects, consultants, contractors, and site teams to ensure successful project execution while maintaining quality, safety, and compliance standards.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering
* 2 to 5 years of relevant experience
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and technical drafting



  





**Requirements** 



* Experience in quantity surveying and BOQ preparation
* Knowledge of site inspection and supervision
* Ability to read and interpret architectural and structural drawings
* Good understanding of construction methods and materials
* Strong communication and coordination skills



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Prepare and review technical drawings
* Conduct site inspections and monitor project progress
* Supervise site activities as per drawings and specifications
* Prepare quantities, BOQs, and measurements
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and project teams
